name: Cassava-leaf stir-fry
summary: Young cassava leaves and male papaya flowers stir-fried with steamed scad over a very low flame. Bitter, fatty, and hot. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 26 Jul 2023 names lá mì xào cá hấp as an Êđê rainy-season plate.
howToEat: The article says the leaves are picked when the cassava tops rise in the rains. Pound the young leaves. Bone steamed scad. Boil male papaya flowers briefly to cut the bitter. Fry lemongrass and scallion bulb in pork fat, then stir-fry everything on a very low flame so the leaves stay moist and the flowers stay crisp. Add chili. A price is Check on arrival.
where: A street was not printed. The same article served lá mì xào at a tasting on Đường sách cà phê. Where to order it on an ordinary day is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: La mi xao — cassava leaves and steamed scad
seoDescription: Young cassava leaves and male papaya flowers stir-fried with steamed scad on a low flame. A street and a price are Check on arrival.
taste: Bao Dak Lak on 26 Jul 2023 calls the plate bitter from the leaves and the flowers, fatty from the pork fat and the fish, and hot from xiêm chili.
